title: Onye Ọrịa Na-anaghị Akwụsị
intro: N'akụkọ ihe mere eme nke amụma, mmadụ ole na ole atachiwo obi n'ọnwụ na nhụjuanya anụ ahụ dị otú a site n'okwukwe na-enweghị atụ. Akụkọ onye a bụ ihe mmụta na-adịghị agwụ agwụ n'inwe ndidi na ntụkwasị obi n'amamihe Chineke. Ònye bụ mkpụrụ obi a?
clues: Allah họpụtara m ka m ziga ozi, mana ule kachasị m bịara abụghị site n'ịjụ, kama site na ọdachi nke onwe.
A napụrụ m akụnụba m, anụ ụlọ m, na ụmụ m otu otu.
Ahụ́ m jupụtara na ọnya, m wee hapụ naanị m ma e wezụga nkwado di m ma ọ bụ nwunye m.
M tikuru Onyenwe m, na-ekweta na m na-ata ahụhụ ma na-achọ ebere Ya.
E nyere m iwu ka m jiri ụkwụ m kụọ ala, mmiri na-eme ka m dị jụụ wee gbapụta.
Allah weghachiri m ahụike m ma nye m ezinụlọ ọhụrụ na ọbụna akụnụba karịa ka m nwere na mbụ.

trial.label: Nnwale/Ihe Omume
options: Ịkewapụ onwe gị n'ezinụlọ ma ree gị ka ọ bụrụ ohu
A na-anwale ya site n'iji nwa ehi ọlaedo

arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَآ أَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ بِنُصْبٍۢ وَعَذَابٍ
verse: And remember Our servant Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, Satan has touched me with hardship and torment." (38:41)
